scope: The surviving public heritage ensemble at Shivneri: the seven stepped entrance gates and immediately connected stonework, Shivai Devi’s outer shrine, the Amberkhana vaults, summit memorial group and stone birthplace, Badami tank edge, Idgah and Kadelot. It is shown on the existing ridge. Rock-cut interiors and unidentified ruins are outside scope.

originalReview.notes: Confirmed the named original grant and archived exact photograph. Verified the Qualla crop against the original photograph, which shows the same scarp/masonry silhouette.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with published Qualla imagery. The known landscape photo has an explicit release by its uploader and a full documented digital crop history. The publisher crop differs only in framing, minor pixel processing and a removed date stamp below the subject. Other gallery and supplemental photographs were not used because they are attribution/share-alike, show the wrong subject, or have inconsistent original source credit.
